summary: Architectural sheet 25 of 28 showing enlarged toilet room plans, fixture/accessory layouts, signage, door jamb, lavatory, and accessory schedule details. One apparent signage-mounting inconsistency and one potentially erroneous lavatory plumbing note warrant clarification. Referenced door schedule and plumbing drawings are listed in the submitted sheet index but were not reviewed.

drafts.title: Signage mounting criteria appear internally inconsistent
drafts.observation: The signage detail shows the tactile-sign zone as “48" MIN. AFF. B. OF BRAILLE” and “60" MAX. AFF. T. OF TACTILE.” The signage notes also state that the mounting height is “60" above the finished floor to the centerline of the sign.” These are different reference points for the same sign and may produce conflicting installation locations.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Detail 4, TYP. SIGNAGE HEIGHT ELEVATION, labels the sign limits as “48" MIN. AFF. B. OF BRAILLE” and “60" MAX. AFF. T. OF TACTILE.” The signage notes immediately below the elevation state that the mounting height is 60 inches above the finished floor to the sign centerline.
drafts.drawing_location: Right side of sheet, Detail 4 and SIGNAGE NOTES below the elevation
drafts.recommendation: Clarify whether the controlling dimension is to the bottom of braille/top of tactile characters or to the sign centerline, and revise the note or elevation so the installation criteria are consistent. Verify the final mounting location against the applicable accessibility standard.

drafts.title: Lavatory flush-valve note uses potentially incorrect fixture terminology
drafts.observation: General Note 3 directs the contractor to “PROVIDE AUTOMATIC FLUSH VALVES ON ALL LAVATORIES, TOILETS & URINALS.” Automatic flush valves are identified together with toilets and urinals, but the note does not identify the intended automatic lavatory faucet or control type.
drafts.drawing_evidence: General Notes, Note 3, states: “PROVIDE AUTOMATIC FLUSH VALVES ON ALL LAVATORIES, TOILETS & URINALS.”
drafts.recommendation: Coordinate this note with the plumbing fixture schedule and revise the lavatory portion to identify the intended automatic faucet/control, if that is the design intent. The plumbing fixture schedule is referenced on the sheet but was not reviewed here.
